notes.title: It’s Launch Time! Food Truck Shop Simulator is OUT NOW in Early Access!
notes.notes:
[p]Food Truck Shop Simulator is officially LIVE on Steam in Early Access![/p][p][/p][p]Customize your own food truck, cook mouthwatering street food, navigate busy city streets, and build your brand one satisfied customer at a time. From juicy burgers to sweet desserts – the road to food truck glory starts now![/p][p][/p][p]🚚 This is just the beginning - join us on the journey as we continue expanding the game based on your feedback.
[/p][p]🎥 Want to see it in action? Join our launch day livestream and watch the devs show off the game live![/p][p][/p][p]🛒 Play now and be part of shaping the future of Food Truck Shop Simulator![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Food Truck Shop Simulator Release Postponed - Coming Next Week!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone - we’ve got a quick update.
[/p][p]We were aiming to launch Food Truck Shop Simulator in Early Access today, but we underestimated how much time we’d need to wrap things up properly. That’s on us – and we’re truly sorry for the delay.
[/p][p]The good news? We’re almost there! We just need a few extra days to polish the final touches and ensure a smoother launch experience for everyone. The new release date is planned for next week.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXft_TNevUbhUU9oDRCAmL9OkqAB_Hu8q9r_Rdaq-78a_dBupDRT10TGuOQjIDJcIDXT2JafU6utItjXR3W9WHdmgkVze_mo8oljZKV83mwpbDqvHYA7mPeh0drlTYzNkgkj54B_FA?key=f2ALyYQHVTX4EDgRWx5S8A"][/img] Thank you for your patience and support. We can’t wait to get you behind the wheel of your own food truck and start this journey together!
[/p][p]In the meantime, make sure to follow the page to stay updated![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Food Truck Shop Simulator Launches on June 27 - Rule the Street Food Scene!
notes.notes:
[p]We're excited to share that Food Truck Shop Simulator is launching on June 27!

[/p][p]Turn an old van into a fully customized food truck and hit the streets with your own tasty menu - juicy burgers, crispy fries, sweet desserts, and more. Cook fast, drive smart, and serve customers before they lose patience.

[/p][p]Unlock new neighborhoods, compete in food festivals, and grow your brand. Attract influencers, outshine rival trucks, and rise to become a street food legend

[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfFsjY4eHnAnc0X0riaV8F0kG6YT5B3znujylb8IE5AZsOlDK5dtNC5KVVHqQJ1jK5q0ISNgFKuBxUeuOoZ2MUXbmiYoBjO-mRl6xzq6qH5r1wnLnyRZi5BPGiuNkb7Wi-N5wHVKQ?key=f2ALyYQHVTX4EDgRWx5S8A"][/img] Hit that wishlist now and be the first on the streets when we launch June 27!
[/p]
